title: DIRECTV Latin America
description: directvla.com Revenue $770.9 Million DIRECTV Latin America, operating under Vrio Corp. and owned by Argentine conglomerate Grupo Werthein since its 2021 buyout from AT&T, is a major satellite TV, streaming and telecom operator serving roughly 10 million subscribers across 11 South American and Caribbean markets. Generating about 771 million dollars in revenue in its regional corporate unit, it leads across Argentina, Colombia, Chile, Peru, Ecuador, Uruguay and the Caribbean through postpaid and cash-prepaid TV models. Beyond satellite broadcasting, it runs the DGO streaming platform, owns DSports holding premier FIFA World Cup and CONMEBOL football rights, and operates the 24/7 news channel DNews. Under Grupo Werthein it has expanded rapidly into fiber broadband via DFibra across five countries. In June 2024 it became Amazon Project Kuiper's exclusive satellite internet distributor in seven South American nations to rival Starlink, while bundling Max, Disney+ and Prime Video.
